name: Chen Zihan
current_role: Co-founder and chief engineer, Bambu Lab (Shenzhen)
profile: Chen Zihan is one of the former DJI engineers who co-founded Bambu Lab in November 2020; at DJI he was reported to have run the gimbal department (motion-control/stabilisation). Bambu Lab now makes some of the world's best-selling consumer 3D printers (X1, P1, A1, H2 lines) and was valued around $6B.
interesting_fact: Bambu Lab's founders deliberately applied DJI's precision machinery, motion control and machine-vision know-how to desktop 3D printing; the X1 used lidar-based bed levelling and first-layer inspection.
deep_cut_fact: Before Bambu Lab, Chen was responsible for gimbal systems at DJI, the camera-stabilisation tech at the heart of DJI's drones and handhelds.
notes: Name also appears as 陈子涵/陈子寒 in Chinese press; very low public profile, no personal accounts found. Route via Bambu Lab media channel.

name: Delian Asparouhov
current_role: Co-founder, President and Chairman, Varda Space Industries; Partner, Founders Fund
profile: MIT-trained (dropped out as a Thiel Fellow) investor and founder. After his YC-backed health startup Nightingale stalled, he followed Keith Rabois to Founders Fund (partner since 2019), where he incubated Varda in 2020 with ex-SpaceX engineer Will Bruey to manufacture drugs in orbit. He remains Varda's president while investing at Founders Fund.
interesting_fact: Varda was conceived and incubated inside Founders Fund; Asparouhov recruited Bruey through a close MIT friend who had become a senior SpaceX executive.
deep_cut_fact: He was fascinated with space as a teenager and interned at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory while still in high school, years before founding Varda.
notes: Very active and outspoken on X (@zebulgar); a well-known podcast guest on space/defense tech and reindustrialisation. X is likely the most responsive route.

name: Pedro Sinogas
current_role: Co-founder and former CEO/CTO of Tekever (current role unclear)
profile: Pedro Sinogas co-founded Tekever in 2001 with Instituto Superior Técnico classmates Ricardo Mendes and Vítor Cristina and led it as CEO and majority shareholder until 2018. Tekever later became Portugal's drone unicorn (valued >EUR1.2B in 2025); per an aggregator profile he also founded Mobizy (2009) and later consulted for Sky.
interesting_fact: Tekever started as a software house serving banks, insurers and telcos before pivoting around 2010 into AI-enabled surveillance drones now used over the English Channel and in Ukraine.
notes: Sensitive: Observador reports a 2018 court-ordered removal as CEO amid a shareholder dispute and seizure of his 52% stake; current stake/role unverified. Avoid Tekever as a route; approach cautiously or deprioritise.

name: Ben Blackmore
profile: Dutch-educated engineer who spent six years at Instana leading frontend architecture, distributed tracing, ingestion and real-user monitoring through its IBM acquisition, then worked at Steadybit. Co-founded Dash0 in 2023 and as CTO leads engineering, now integrating acquisitions Lumigo and Polar Signals; Dash0 reached a $1B valuation in 2026.
interesting_fact: At Instana he grew the UI contributor community from a handful of people to over 80.
deep_cut_fact: He studied at Fontys University of Applied Sciences in Venlo, the Netherlands, and still works there as an external expert. He previously published as Ben Ripkens (GitHub: bripkens).
notes: Appeared on Dash0's Code RED podcast (ep. 20). Technical, builder-oriented; AI-in-SDLC observability is his current theme.
